name: zrndr_commit_staged_fog_params_if_changed
description: zRndr::CommitStagedFogParamsIfChanged copies staged target fog params to the active params when any RGB channel differs by at least 0.01.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zRndr fog helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x49b710 shows fabs(active RGB - staged RGB) comparisons against 0.01 and a 0xa0-byte copy from g_fogTargetParamsStaged to g_fogParamsActive when any channel reaches the threshold.
The native smokes verify below-threshold staged differences do not update active fog params, while staged target color paths can commit changed packed fog params.
